cases.name: Normal runtime and new-process identical retry
cases.expectation: One cycle and stable complete report

cases.name: External kill after runtime cycle commit before report
cases.expectation: Committed cycle survives and restart materializes original report

cases.name: External kill after outbox commit before eml
cases.expectation: Original outbox reused and one eml materialized

cases.name: Original workflow outbox-publication gap
cases.expectation: Test suspected report/outbox hash mismatch; preserve observed failure

cases.name: Versioned workflow with durable publication intent
cases.expectation: Same gap leaves original report SHA bound to outbox and publication

cases.name: External kill after send_started before DATA
cases.expectation: Zero DATA, UNKNOWN after restart, no automatic resend; possible delivery loss

cases.name: External kill after DATA250 before sent commit
cases.expectation: One accepted DATA, UNKNOWN after restart, no automatic resend

cases.name: Receiver disconnects after complete DATA before250
cases.expectation: One received DATA, no250, UNKNOWN after restart, no automatic resend

prior_covered_excluded: Existing uncommitted SQLite child os._exit77 rollback test is not a new result

fixture_substitutions: All history is invented and marked synthetic
Workflow discover stage is explicitly prefilled as an offline stub; AnySearch is not tested
Fault hook calls real Store.append and only pauses before or after the named side effect
SMTP uses a local test CA trusted only by the child, with TLS hostname checking enabled
